long_biography.plain_text:
In 1996, Mario Germano Giuliani and his father met Pablo Legorreta at an airport in Milan. Their encounter led the pharmaceutical family to invest in his new company, Royalty Pharma, which acquired rights to income from medicines. They used proceeds from Giuliani's existing business and committed more capital before the flotation. The investment became a major source of Mario's wealth.

Giuliani also funds medical research. With Lisa Giuliani, he made a gift to Dana-Farber Cancer Institute for work on multiple myeloma. It supports a clinical trial examining earlier use of immunotherapies, alongside laboratory research on resistance to treatment. They also established a Swiss foundation supporting healthcare, culture and art.
long_biography.html:
In 1996, Mario Germano Giuliani and his father met Pablo Legorreta at an airport in Milan. Their encounter led the pharmaceutical family to invest in his new company, Royalty Pharma, which acquired rights to income from medicines. They used proceeds from Giuliani's existing business and committed more capital before the flotation. The investment became a major source of Mario's wealth.

Giuliani also funds medical research. With Lisa Giuliani, he made a gift to Dana-Farber Cancer Institute for work on multiple myeloma. It supports a clinical trial examining earlier use of immunotherapies, alongside laboratory research on resistance to treatment. They also established a Swiss foundation supporting healthcare, culture and art.
